paite: Ngai dih ua, Toupa Sepaihte’ PATHIAN in Jerusalem a kipan leh Judah a kipan amuanpi uleh achiang uh, amuanpi uh an tengteng leh amuanpi uh tui tengteng, alaksak hi.
heading: Jerusalem A Buaizakna
english: For, behold, the Lord, Yahweh of Armies, takes away from Jerusalem and from Judah supply and support, the whole supply of bread, and the whole supply of water;

paite: Mihat leh kidousiamte toh; vaihawmmi leh zawlnei leh aisan siam leh upate toh;
english: the mighty man, the man of war, the judge, the prophet, the diviner, the elder,

paite: sawmnga heutu leh mizahtakhuai leh lemthei mi leh khutsiam leh thugensiamte toh.
english: the captain of fifty, the honorable man, the counselor, the skilled craftsman, and the clever enchanter.

paite: Huchi in amiliante uh hi ding in naupangte ka pe ding a, naungekte'n atung uah vai ahawm ding uh.
english: I will give boys to be their princes, and children shall rule over them.

paite: Huchi in mite nuaisiah in a-om ding ua, michih kinuaisiah in a-om ding uh, michih amau invengte toh kinuaisiah in a-om ding uh; naupang upa tung ah kisatheitak in a-om ding ua, mithulimloupi nangawn mizahtakhuai tung ah kisatheitak in a-om ding.
english: The people will be oppressed, everyone by another, and everyone by his neighbor. The child will behave himself proudly against the old man, and the base against the honorable.

paite: Mi'n apa inn a-unau len in, "Nang silh-le-ten na nei a, ka vaihawmtu un om inla, hiai siatna na khut ah om heh," achih chiang in.
english: Indeed a man shall take hold of his brother in the house of his father, saying, “You have clothing, you be our ruler, and let this ruin be under your hand.”

paite: Huai chiang in amah apau khe ding a, "Kei zaw bawlhoihtu in ka om kei ding hi; ka inn ah nek ding a-om kei a, silh-le-ten leng a-om kei; mite vaihawmpa in na hon bawl kei ding," chi in.
english: In that day he will cry out, saying, “I will not be a healer; for in my house is neither bread nor clothing. You shall not make me ruler of the people.”

paite: Athupina mit vuisak ding a apau uleh athilhihte uh TOUPA dou lam ahih ziak in Jerusalem ase khin a, Judahte apuk khinta uhi.
english: For Jerusalem is ruined, and Judah is fallen; because their tongue and their doings are against Yahweh, to provoke the eyes of his glory.

paite: Amel latdan in amau ahek tawm a; akhelhna uh Sodom bangtak in alangsak ua, a-iim kei uh. Atung uh agik e! Thil hoih lou in akithuk tawm ngal ua.
english: The look of their faces testify against them. They parade their sin like Sodom. They don’t hide it. Woe to their soul! For they have brought disaster upon themselves.

paite: Midiktat thu ah ahoih ding uhi, chi un; athilhih gahte uh lah ane sin ngal ua.
english: Tell the righteous “Good!” For they shall eat the fruit of their deeds.

paite: Migiloute tung agik hi! Lah ase sin ngal ua; akhut ua thilhih thukna akiang ua piak ahih ding ziak in.
english: Woe to the wicked! Disaster is upon them; for the deeds of his hands will be paid back to him.

paite: Ka mite zaw, amau nuaisiahtute naupangte ahita ua, numeite'n atung uah vai ahawmta uhi. Ka mite aw, nou hon pite'n ahon pikhial ua, na paina lamte ahihse sek uhi.
english: As for my people, children are their oppressors, and women rule over them. My people, those who lead you cause you to err, and destroy the way of your paths.

paite: TOUPA genpih ding in ahong dingkhia a, mite vaihawm ding in ahong dinghta hi.
heading: TOUPA'N Amite Vai Ahawm
english: Yahweh stands up to contend, and stands to judge the peoples.

paite: TOUPA'N a mi upate tung ah leh amau miliante tung ah vai ahawm ding: TOUPA Sepaihte' TOUPA'N, "Noute na hi uh grephuan negaite; na innte uah ahi mitagahte a kipan a sumlakte a-om;
english: Yahweh will enter into judgment with the elders of his people, and their leaders: “It is you who have eaten up the vineyard. The spoil of the poor is in your houses.

paite: bang achia ahia ka mite na at ua, tagahte mai na gawizan uh?" Toupa, Sepaihte' TOUPA'N achi hi.
english: What do you mean that you crush my people, and grind the face of the poor?” says the Lord, Yahweh of Armies.

paite: Huai lou in TOUPA'N, "Zion tanute kisatheitak a a-om ua, dak vuauvuau leh mi en loplop in apai ua, apai un apai lohloh ua, akhete uh asuan ging thuapthuap ziak un.
heading: Jerusalem Numeite Vauhilhna
english: Moreover Yahweh said, “Because the daughters of Zion are haughty, and walk with outstretched necks and flirting eyes, walking to trip as they go, jingling ornaments on their feet;

paite: Toupa'n Zion tanute luzang ah meima khem a-omsak ding a, TOUPA'N azahmohte uh leng adawksak ding," achi hi.
english: therefore the Lord brings sores on the crown of the head of the women of Zion, and Yahweh will make their scalps bald.”

paite: Huai ni chiang in Toupa'n akizepna hoihnate uh alaksak ding a, khebulhte, len lukhute, hakkolte;
english: In that day the Lord will take away the beauty of their anklets, the headbands, the crescent necklaces,

paite: bilbah kai ngiahngiahte, taute, kikhuhna puante;
english: the earrings, the bracelets, the veils,

paite: lutang puante, khebulh khainiangte, kawng a tente, gimlim bawmte, kikaunate;
english: the headdresses, the ankle chains, the sashes, the perfume bottles, the charms,

paite: minsawnna zungbuhte, nakbulhte;
english: the signet rings, the nose rings,

paite: ankuangluina vante, puanaktualte, puansilhte, kawlzalte;
english: the fine robes, the capes, the cloaks, the purses,

paite: limlangte, puanmalngatte, dialte, kituamhoihna puante.
english: the hand mirrors, the fine linen garments, the tiaras, and the shawls.

paite: Thaunamtui sik in thilmuat a-om ding; kawnggak sik in khauzen a-om ding; sam mam sik in talkolh a-om ding; puan kilawmtak sik in sai-ip puan a-om ding; melhoih sik in meikang pawn a-om ding hi.
english: It shall happen that instead of sweet spices, there shall be rottenness; instead of a belt, a rope; instead of well set hair, baldness; instead of a robe, a wearing of sackcloth; and branding instead of beauty.

paite: Namsau in na mite vatpaih ahi ding ua, na mihat mahmahte kidouna ah apuk ding uh.
english: Your men shall fall by the sword, and your mighty in the war.

paite: Akulh kongkhakte ah awm kitum in akap ding ua; ahawm a nutsiat ahi ding ua, lei ah atu ding hi.
english: Her gates shall lament and mourn; and she shall be desolate and sit on the ground.
